annotations.title: Buy a phone number from Cosend

description: Buys one local US or Canadian phone number from Cosend for WhatsApp, named by its phone_number and country as the search of available numbers returned them (with its locality and region), and returns it as a Cosend number (cnm_…), usually verifying. It charges the workspace’s card, so it acts only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it buys nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve. The preview shows the price of a number, its interval (month or year, as the plan is billed), when it renews and the amount charged today for the rest of the billing period; the price, interval and renewal are read again when the token comes back, and if any changed the token is refused. Changing a single character of the arguments invalidates the token too. Only a person’s approval buys it: the credential alone buys nothing, through this tool or straight to the API. On a paid plan with a card on file, for owners and admins, up to the plan’s number limit; five a minute and ten a day per workspace. The number is on the Numbers page of the Cosend dashboard too.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.
